photos.name: both-loaves-angle
photos.summary: Both loaves from a low angle — loaf 2 (foreground, wire rack) shows defined single score with ear lifting cleanly, banneton spiral pattern visible. Loaf 1 (background, cutting board) has a less defined shape from the shaping mishap.

photos.name: both-loaves-wide
photos.summary: Wide shot of both finished loaves side by side on the kitchen counter. Loaf 1 (left, cutting board) with blistered crust and less structure. Loaf 2 (right, wire rack) with clean ear and tight banneton rings. Clear contrast between the two.

photos.name: loaf1-side-view
photos.summary: Loaf 1 side view on cutting board — more spread out shape reflecting the shaping issue. Blistered, rustic crust with flour dusting. Score opened but without a distinct ear.

photos.name: loaf2-ear-closeup
photos.summary: Close-up of loaf 2 on wire rack — single score near the top produced a pronounced ear with golden caramelized flap. Banneton ring pattern clearly visible across the crust. Good oven spring, round boule shape.
